description: MCP server for the Google Slides API: presentations, slides, text, shapes, images and tables.
name: io.github.A1-x-Tech/mcp-google-slides

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 client secret (refresh-token flow). Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SLIDES_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: Google OAuth2 refresh token, exchanged for access tokens automatically. Treat it as a secret.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SLIDES_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Static OAuth2 access token (~1h lifetime) — alternative to the refresh-token trio, mostly for testing.
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SLIDES_ACCESS_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Drive API root override (used internally for comments, export and image upload).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SLIDES_DRIVE_API_BASE

environmentVariables.description: Retries on transient errors (429 always; 5xx/network for reads).
environmentVariables.name: GOOGLE_SLIDES_MAX_RETRIES

title: Google Slides MCP
